name: create_task
description: Create or add a new task, todo item, reminder, or scheduled activity with a title.

title.description: The title or description of the task to create

name: list_pending_tasks
description: List, show, or display all currently pending, open, or unfinished tasks and todos.

name: complete_task
description: Complete, mark done, or finish a task by its numeric ID.

task_id.description: The numeric ID of the task to complete

name: user_report_task_completion
description: Record the user's statement that they personally finished or completed a task.

task_id.description: The numeric ID of the task the user reported completed

name: cancel_task
description: Cancel, delete, remove, or abandon an existing task by its numeric task ID.

task_id.description: The numeric ID of the task to cancel or delete

name: complete_all_tasks
description: Complete, finish, or mark done all pending tasks at once.

name: list_completed_tasks
description: Show, list, or check recently completed or finished tasks.

name: log_expense
description: Record an expense, spending, money paid, purchase, or financial transaction.

amount.description: The numerical amount of money spent

description.description: What the money was spent on or purpose of payment

name: summarize_expenses
description: Check total money spent, expense summary, or financial expenditure balance.

name: log_journal
description: Save, jot down, or record a personal note, thought, idea, or journal entry.

content.description: The note content, thought, or idea to save

name: list_journal
description: Read, display, show, or list saved notes, thoughts, or journal entries.

name: list_alarms
description: Check, display, or list active alarms, timers, or scheduled reminders.

name: cancel_alarms
description: Turn off, stop, dismiss, or cancel all active alarms or reminders.

name: daily_briefing
description: Get the daily briefing, morning overview, agenda, or day plan summary.

name: create_goal
description: Create or set a new long-term personal or professional goal.

title.description: The title or description of the goal

name: list_goals
description: List, show, or review active goals and long-term targets.

name: create_project
description: Create or start a new project or initiative.

name: list_projects
description: List, display, or review active projects.
